notes.title: Release date is delayed
notes.notes: We are working on multiple projects right now, and we had to concentrate on Wordeous and don't want to rush Substantia Cana since we want it to be perfect before release. Substantia Cana won't be available in early access and will be released in full version. In order to make it perfect before the release we had to delay Substantia Cana. It will be released in the first half of 2021. Thank you for your patience and understanding. In the meantime you can check out Wordeous!
